column1: # Going Commando: moby classes that keep the game's own draw distance at every Draw distance.
# A longer Draw distance shows mobys the game would hide. Some classes need that hiding: the game
# parks them out of sight, or their data puts them far away. List such a class here.
# Fields, split by tabs: class number, levels, name, reason. game/common/draw_distance_list.h reads
# it. The reason says what goes wrong when the class is drawn farther.

column4: The game parks each board out of sight (Barlow's at z 31 under the floor). Only the pieces' short draw distances (64, 128) keep them hidden there.
Waits under the ice and bursts out when the hero comes near. Drawn farther, the sleeping ones show from far away before they come out.
The game shows and runs them only near the hero. Drawn farther, the sleeping ones show from far away, standing still where they wait.
